items.headline: Texas rises to No. 1 in AP Top 25; Ohio State, Oregon tumble
items.description: The unprecedented comeback by Texas to knock off Ohio State moved the Longhorns to No. 1 in the AP Top 25 and pushed the Buckeyes out of the top five for the first time in two seasons.

items.headline: Hammond throws go-ahead touchdown pass and No. 13 Texas Tech downs Oregon State 35-24
items.description: — Will Hammond hit Coy Eakin with a 32-yard touchdown pass with 6:31 left to put Texas Tech in front and the No. 13 Red Raiders went on to a 35-24 comeback victory over resilient Oregon State on Saturday night.
